patterns.note: Full-screen, high-contrast hero sections with centered, oversized typography are used for primary branding and page introductions, creating a dramatic initial impression.
A stark black and white color palette is used exclusively, creating a high-contrast, sophisticated, and minimal aesthetic throughout the site.
A distinctive, elegant serif typeface is used for the main brand name and primary headings, contrasted with a clean, all-caps sans-serif for supporting text, subheadings, and navigation.
The initial hero section scrolls up, revealing a smaller, sticky header with the brand name. Concurrently, a star icon above the brand name animates its form during this scroll transition.
Content is organized into distinct, full-width sections that alternate between black and white backgrounds, maintaining clear visual separation and a strong vertical rhythm.

technique_notes: The initial hero section occupies the full viewport, with its content (large brand name, tagline, and call to action) positioned centrally. As the user scrolls, this hero content translates upwards, eventually disappearing from view. Simultaneously, a smaller, sticky header containing the brand name appears at the top of the viewport. The star icon within the hero animates its shape during the scroll transition, likely using a Lottie animation to transform from two stars to four.
Subsequent content sections are revealed with a subtle fade-in and slight upward translation effect as they enter the viewport, creating a smooth, staggered appearance.

design_tokens.type_scale: An extremely oversized, elegant serif for the hero brand name (~8x body) with small, uppercase sans-serif subheadings and body text.
design_tokens.spacing: very airy, with generous vertical padding between sections and ample letter-spacing on uppercase text.

standout: The site's distinctive use of a full-screen, high-contrast black and white hero with an animating logo and oversized serif typography immediately conveys a sense of luxury and authority. The dramatic scroll-triggered transformation of the hero into a minimal sticky header is a key memorable interaction.
